title: Bring B to the front
summary: z-index: 999 loses to 3. Fix it without touching either number.
brief: B has z-index: 999 and A has z-index: 3, yet A is painted over B.
Make B appear above A where they overlap, but keep A's and B's z-index values exactly as they are.
hints: Select B and open the Layout tab: which stacking context does it paint in?
.group creates a stacking context (position: relative with a z-index). Everything inside it, B included, is painted at the group's level: 1.
Raise the group above A (z-index: 4), or stop it creating a context at all (z-index: auto).
solutionNotes: z-index only compares elements inside the same stacking context. .group (relative, z-index 1) formed a context painted at level 1, below A at 3, and B's 999 only counted inside it. Without the group's z-index there is no context, so B's 999 competes with A's 3 directly.
